steps.note: The ricotta is left to drip in a sieve in the fridge overnight.
Eggs set the baked filling, where an unbaked one uses cream.

steps.name: bake
steps.note: The filling bakes on a crumb crust in a water bath for about an hour and a quarter, until the centre is set.
It is cooled on a rack and then chilled for about four hours before serving.

sources.text: One tested recipe for the draining, baking and chilling figures, and Wikipedia for ricotta as a cheesecake cheese and for eggs in baked versus cream in unbaked ones; recipes differ.
